thread:
Marta Chen: Quick sketch — thinking of a permission heatmap in Console that shows role inheritance across tenants + quota exposure per route. Useful for audits and onboarding.
Samir Patel: curious — is this purely visual or do we plan an API-backed "effective permissions" endpoint as well?
Marta Chen: both. UX shows heatmap, clicking a cell calls `GET /v1/tenants/:t/effective-perms?route=/generate` and shows which role granted which action and whether it's throttled by quota.
Josh (eng-platform): love it. main questions:
• data volume — compute effective perms on the fly vs precompute nightly
• accuracy — show ancestry chain vs flattened effective list
Emily - PM: stakeholders: support + sales for audits, infra for quota debugging, customers (enterprise) for compliance. We need export CSV and link to telemetry.
Samir Patel: for on-the-fly compute, cache keys could be `tenant:route:roleset:vX`. But race with role changes. Maybe short TTL + webhook to invalidate.
Marta Chen: agreed. POC uses precompute for active roles and a fast fallback compute path. heatmap rows=roles, cols=routes (or route groups). cell shows: permitted / denied / limited (+quota percent).
dev-bot: deploy ci/heatmap-poc -> success :rocket:
Josh (eng-platform): UI mockup attached in figma (link pasted). UX concern: surface scope nuance (e.g., scoped tokens that only allow specific sub-routes). We should show a hover with the policy snippet.
Samir Patel: API contract debate: do we return full policy text or policy references (id + link)? Returning full text = easier for offline export; references = smaller payload.
Marta Chen: compromise: return `policy_ref` and `policy_snippet` (first ~256 chars). UI can fetch full policy lazily.
Emily - PM: also need telemetry hooks: when support clicks a cell, we should log `heatmap_click` with `role,route,tenant,computed_at` so we can link to traces/requests.
Josh (eng-platform): quota overlay: show current usage % from metrics API `/v1/tenants/:t/quotas/usage?route=...`. fallback shows last-known number and timestamp.
Samir Patel: edge case: inherited denies. we must bold denies in UI and show precedence. Also handle service accounts separately.
Marta Chen: next steps: I'll land a small API POC returning effective perms + snippets, Josh will wire UI mockup, Samir will add cache invalidation webhook. Emily will scope export & telemetry. I'll open ticket to track.
Emily - PM: thanks team — can we have a short sync Wed 10am to align on API shape and telemetry fields? :thumbsup:
Josh (eng-platform): +1
Samir Patel: +1
Marta Chen: done — created ticket #INFR-8421 and put PR link in thread.
